subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST.------TRS.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 113 (T(AF)M-17). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From DYM-SPT: TR-INFO (trans-information). From ACC-FT: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). From TR-INFO: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From LK-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From C-CULT-AT: PART (participation). From PART: AFI (affinity insight).
